archetype: Colorless Big-Mana Acceleration / Symmetric Burn Exploitation
core_engine: Precombat damage to opponents triggers Belbe postcombat main phase colorless mana yield ({C}{C} per opponent who lost life, up to 6 {C}) to cast high-CMC colorless threats on early turns.

engine_stages.trigger: Early pingers and group burn (Night Market Lookout, Pulse Tracker, Vicious Conquistador, Leechridden Swamp)
engine_stages.converter: Belbe, Corrupted Observer postcombat main phase mana yield
engine_stages.payoff: High-CMC colorless bombs and artifact finishers (Portal to Phyrexia, Ulamog, Wurmcoil Engine, Cityscape Leveler)

expected_additions.rationale: Provides hexproof protection for Belbe against targeted removal and haste to enable immediate attacks from pingers.
Provides critical graveyard recursion for high-value payoffs removed by opponents, replacing an unreliable Turn-2 condition.

specific_checks.description: Primary high-CMC colorless payoff enabled by Belbe trigger.
Off-tempo 4-mana gimmick that does not reliably trigger Belbe on curve.
Fragile 1-mana dork redundant next to Belbe's 6-mana yield and vulnerable to sweepers.
Redundant, non-disruptive 7-mana ramp that does not advance the deck's win condition.
Adds mana during upkeep that empties before main phase (CR 106.4) and restricts mana to artifacts.
Requires {2}{B}{B} colored mana pips which Belbe's colorless yield cannot pay, failing calibration if recommended over generic {6} Conduit of Ruin.
